mensagem.pixeldungeon.sem_amuleto: You can't leave the dungeon without the Amulet of Yendor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bloqueado: The way deeper is still blocked.
comando.pixeldungeon.novarun: The run is over. Choose your heroes!
item.pixeldungeon.espada_curta_desgastad: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.
item.pixeldungeon.cajado_do_mago.descric: Crafted by the Mage himself, this staff is a unique magical weapon which can be imbued with a wand.
item.pixeldungeon.adaga.descricao: A simple iron dagger with a worn wooden handle.
item.pixeldungeon.luvas_cravejadas.descr: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.
item.pixeldungeon.florete.descricao: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.
item.pixeldungeon.maca.descricao: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.
item.pixeldungeon.ankh.descricao: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Use it to bring back an ally who has died.
tela.pixeldungeon.run_em_andamento: Someone is already in the dungeon: you will join the current run on depth 1.
classe.pixeldungeon.guerreiro.descricao: The Warrior endures extra damage with shielding granted by his _broken seal._ The seal can be moved between armors and _transfers a single upgrade._
classe.pixeldungeon.mago.descricao: The Mage is an arcane expert and carries a _magical staff_ that's stronger than a wand. The staff can be _imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds.
classe.pixeldungeon.ladino.descricao: The Rogue can evade enemies and strike from invisibility using his _cloak of shadows._ He also _detects secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.
classe.pixeldungeon.cacadora.descricao: The Huntress is a master of thrown weapons and has a _magical bow_ with infinite arrows. She also travels through tall grass _without trampling it._
classe.pixeldungeon.duelista.descricao: The Duelist is a weapons master who can use her weapon to trigger a _special weapon ability._ This special ability is _different for every weapon._
classe.pixeldungeon.clerigo.descricao: The Cleric is a divine spellcaster who uses their unique _holy tome_ to channel divine magic. They can _learn and upgrade spells_ via talents.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.espere_ankh: You died. You are now a spectator until someone uses an ankh on you.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.fim_da_run: All heroes have died. The run is over.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.reviveu: %s was brought back to life by %s's ankh!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ninguem_pra_revive: There is no dead ally to bring back.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.reabrir_menu: Type /heroi to open the hero menu again.
comando.pixeldungeon.ja_na_run: You are already in the run.
